resource_load.note: LoadAttributes loads ALL issue relations unnecessarily

performance_issues.description: ListIssueAttachments calls issue.LoadAttributes which loads ALL issue data (comments, labels, milestones, reactions, etc.) just to extract attachments
performance_issues.impact: For issues with many comments, this loads potentially thousands of records unnecessarily. LoadAttributes also calls Comments.LoadAttributes which loads per-comment data.
performance_issues.recommendation: Replace LoadAttributes with issue.LoadAttachments(ctx) and return convert.ToAPIAttachments directly

optimization_recommendations.description: Only load attachments instead of full issue attributes
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from 12+ queries to 2 queries (issue + attachments)
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Replace issue.LoadAttributes(ctx) with issue.LoadAttachments(ctx), then return convert.ToAPIAttachments(ctx.Repo.Repository, issue.Attachments)
